title: AI Data Center Tenants Demand More Than $5 Million Daily Penalties for Construction Delays
summary:
Tenants of AI data centers are tightening delivery contracts, requesting daily fines if developers fail to provide power and facilities by agreed-upon dates. Demands for these penalties have risen to more than $5 million per day, up from about $1 million earlier this year, based on a report from The Information.

A seven-month delay could leave a developer owing an AI tenant more than $1 billion in fees, before accounting for lost rental income. KKR warned that such late fees could lead to more developer bankruptcies than rising interest rates, as constraints in power and cooling hamper AI expansion. Amazon executive Andy Jassy noted that AWS is already booking capacity into 2028.
